out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at kitchen handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC provided paper towels at kitchen handwashing sink.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed soy sauce, salad oil, frying oil stored directly on the floor in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC moved the aforementioned food items onto dunnage.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: Observed cardboards lining on the shelves of the carts used for rice pots.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. PIC removed cardboards from the shelves.

violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. PIC removed cardboards from the shelves.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed the buckets of soy sauce and salad oil/Soya bean stored directly on the floor next to freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC moved the buckets of soy sauce and salad oil/Soya bean to approved shelving.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the kitchen is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. Observed that access to the handwashing sink is blocked by boxes of brown sugar.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC removed boxes of brown sugar from handwashing sink to provide access for proper handwashing.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the kitchen being used for thawing frozen tuna and salmon.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC trained employees on designated use of the handwashing sink. PIC moved raw tuna and raw salmon to walk-in cooler.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed raw tuna and raw salmon thawing in unopened vacuum-sealed packaging in walk-in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: EHS discussed the proper thawing methods for ROP fish. PIC opened the vacuum-sealed packaging of raw tuna and raw salmon for proper thawing.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: raw tuna, raw salmon thawing at room temperature in the handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. PIC trained employees on the proper methods of thawing

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: bins of rice.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC labeled bins of rice.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED MULTIPLE BAGS OF CUT CABBAGE (MMIXED WITH BROCCOLI AND CARROTS) AT 43-47F, RAW CHICKEN AT 45-48F, AND RAW BEEF AT 51-55F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF ONE BAG OF CABBAGE IN UNIT AND MOVED ALL OTHER BAGS, RAW CHICKEN, AND RAW BEEF TO OTHER COLD HOLDING UNITS. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL FOODS MUST REMAIN AT 41F OR BELOW AND THAT THIS UNIT SHOULD NOT BE USED TO HOLD TCS FOODS UNTIL IT HAS BEEN REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED 3-DOOR UPR COOLER IN BACK KITCHEN AT 44-47F WITH EHS THERMOMETER (DIGITAL THERMOMETER READING AT 36F).
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC DISCARDED OF FOODS OR MOVED TCS FOODS IN UNIT TO OTHER COLD HOLDING UNITS. PIC UNDERSTANDS THIS UNIT MAY NOT BE USED TO HOLD TCS FOODS UNTIL IT HAS BEEN REPAIRED AND CAN TRULY HOLD TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.
